DEPLOYMENT RUNBOOK

Strategy
Services are released with blue-green deployments. The new version is deployed next to the old one and traffic is switched only after health checks pass.

Database Migrations
Database migrations run before the traffic switch and must be backwards compatible with the previous release.

Scaling
The horizontal autoscaler keeps between 3 and 12 replicas and adds replicas when average CPU utilisation stays above 65 percent for five minutes.

Rollback
If error rates rise after a release, roll back with kubectl rollout undo and switch traffic back to the previous colour. Rollbacks must be announced in the incident channel.
